subject: Q1 proration: seat-level invoice allocation + VAT reconciliation
messages:
From: Alex Dunn <finance@clearwelllogistics.com>
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: maria.gomez@clearwelllogistics.com
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Q1 invoice proration by seat & VAT split

Hi Priya / Ben,

We completed our internal headcount adjustments mid-quarter and need the Q1 statement to be split pro-rata across seats and routed to two legal entities for VAT purposes. The high-level ask:

- Produce a single downloadable invoice package for our AP team that contains line-level seat proration (start/end dates included)
- Break out VAT by legal entity: Clearwell EU (VAT ID in attached file) and Clearwell US (no VAT)
- Provide a short reconciliation file mapping your invoice rows to our cost-center codes so we can automate accounting.

I attached our cost center map (clearwell_costcenter_map.csv). Can Redwood produce a proforma so we can validate before payment? Also flag any minimum-billing rounding impacts.

Thanks,
Alex Dunn
Head of Finance, Clearwell Logistics
alex.dunn@clearwelllogistics.com

Attachment: clearwell_costcenter_map.csv

From: priya_natarajan@redwood.com <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Alex Dunn <finance@clearwelllogistics.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 23 Mar 2027 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Q1 invoice proration by seat & VAT split

Alex — thanks for the note and the mapping file. Looping in Ben (billing ops) and Lauren (revenue ops) so we can propose a mutually-actionable plan.

Quick clarifying questions so we scope the proforma correctly:
1) Do you want one consolidated invoice PDF with internal attachments per legal entity, or separate PDFs for the EU and US legal entities?
2) Is the effective date for proration the headcount change date included in your CSV (Mar 10), or should we use invoice period boundaries (Mar 1–Mar 31)?
3) Any constraints on how your AP system consumes invoice line references (PO number, cost-center code field, or line tags)?

Planned next steps after we confirm:
- Ben will produce an Excel proforma (seat-level rows + taxes) and a reconciliation CSV that maps Redwood line IDs to your cost centers.
- We'll run a quick VAT sanity check for EU rows and call out any rounding delta.

I expect a draft proforma by Thu (Mar 25).

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Sr. Manager, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: ben_carter@redwood.com <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: priya_natarajan@redwood.com
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, Alex Dunn <finance@clearwelllogistics.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Mar 2027 08:19:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Q1 invoice proration by seat & VAT split

Priya / Alex — attached is the draft proforma worksheet (redwood_proforma_split.xlsx). Notes:

- Rows are seat-level with start/end date and calculated prorated amount based on daily rate.
- We include a column "redwood_line_id" you can push into your GL for automated matching.
- VAT is calculated only on rows assigned to Clearwell EU VAT ID (per your CSV). Rounding is applied at line level; we show a rounding delta row at the bottom.

Open items for Alex:
- Confirm whether you want separate PDFs per legal entity or a single package with two labeled PDFs. Our AP export can do either; separate PDFs is easier for internal Clearwell routing.
- Confirm PO number ingestion: I can populate a PO column if you provide the PO number or accept our invoice-level reference.

Attachment: redwood_proforma_split.xlsx

Ben Carter
Billing Operations Lead
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

From: Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@clearwelllogistics.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, priya_natarajan@redwood.com
Cc: Alex Dunn <finance@clearwelllogistics.com>
Date: Fri, 26 Mar 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Q1 invoice proration by seat & VAT split

Thanks Ben — the worksheet looks good at a glance. A couple clarifications from our side: 

- We prefer separate PDFs per legal entity. It simplifies our VAT reclaim flow.
- PO number to use is CL-Q1-2027-PO42 — please populate that on the invoice.
- On rounding: we prefer any rounding deltas under $1 to be absorbed by vendor (Redwood) and anything $1+ to be itemized. If that's not feasible, we can accept a one-line rounding adjustment with a note.

I've attached a small mapping file (same columns as your redwood_line_id) that adds our internal ledger tags — please use those for the reconciliation CSV.

Thanks,
Maria Gomez
Senior AP Manager, Clearwell Logistics

Attachment: clearwell_costcenter_map_v2.csv

From: priya_natarajan@redwood.com <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Alex Dunn <finance@clearwelllogistics.com>, Maria Gomez <maria.gomez@clearwelllogistics.com>, ben_carter@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Q1 invoice proration by seat & VAT split

Alex / Maria — thanks for the quick turnaround and the updated map. Confirming agreed plan and next steps (Mutual Action Plan):

1) Redwood will produce two PDF invoices (Clearwell US, Clearwell EU) and a zipped reconciliation package containing:
   - proforma_invoice_rows.csv (seat-level lines with redwood_line_id + your ledger tag)
   - final_invoice_US.pdf and final_invoice_EU.pdf
   - summary_reconciliation.xlsx (shows rounding deltas and tax calc)

2) PO: we will place CL-Q1-2027-PO42 on both invoices per your request.
3) Rounding policy: Redwood will absorb rounding deltas < $1 per your preference; anything >= $1 will be a discrete adjustment line labeled "Rounding adjustment - agreed policy".
4) ETA: final package by Wed, Mar 31 COB PT. Payment terms and remittance instructions unchanged.

Attachments: 20270329-proration-mop-draft.pdf (mutual action plan + checklist). Please confirm if this matches your expectations and we'll mark the deal as ready for invoice issuance.

Best regards,
Priya Natarajan
Sr. Manager, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
